Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Packs
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /packs: lists active packs with their number of active products.

Description.description: Workflow for /packs: lists active packs with their number of active products.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Settings
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /mysettings: builds the preferences card (cards/preferences.json) with the caller's packs and products (Microsoft 365 and Azure in separate lists), schedule, look-ahead, critical window, empty-digest choice and pause state.

Description.description: Workflow for /mysettings: builds the preferences card (cards/preferences.json) with the caller's packs and products (Microsoft 365 and Azure in separate lists), schedule, look-ahead, critical window, empty-digest choice and pause state.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Save Preferences
Workflow.Description: Workflow for the Save button of the preferences card: compares the submitted packs, products and settings with the stored ones, adds and removes subscriptions (all or nothing against the per-user cap), updates the subscriber and recomputes the next digest when the schedule changed. Refuses a card built before the caller's last change.

Description.description: Workflow for the Save button of the preferences card: compares the submitted packs, products and settings with the stored ones, adds and removes subscriptions (all or nothing against the per-user cap), updates the subscriber and recomputes the next digest when the schedule changed. Refuses a card built before the caller's last change.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Digest Now
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /digest: builds and posts the caller's digest now with lib digest. Works while paused and leaves ait_nextdueon unchanged.

Description.description: Workflow for /digest: builds and posts the caller's digest now with lib digest. Works while paused and leaves ait_nextdueon unchanged.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Products
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /products [text]: lists active catalog products whose name, display name or aliases contain the text. /products azure lists the Azure products; Azure products are marked in every list.

Description.description: Workflow for /products [text]: lists active catalog products whose name, display name or aliases contain the text. /products azure lists the Azure products; Azure products are marked in every list.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Welcome
Workflow.Description: Workflow for the Welcome topic: creates the caller's ait_subscriber row with the default settings on first contact.

Description.description: Workflow for the Welcome topic: creates the caller's ait_subscriber row with the default settings on first contact.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Unsubscribe
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /unsubscribe (alias /remove): matches each comma-separated name against the caller's own subscriptions in SPEC order and deletes the matches. 'all' deletes every subscription.

Description.description: Workflow for /unsubscribe (alias /remove): matches each comma-separated name against the caller's own subscriptions in SPEC order and deletes the matches. 'all' deletes every subscription.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Details
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /details <id>: calls get_m365_roadmap_by_id on the MCP server (HTTP JSON-RPC, like Harvest) and, when the Microsoft 365 roadmap has no such item, get_azure_update_by_id; an id written as azure-<id> goes to Azure Updates only. Returns the full item. The only agent flow that calls the MCP server.

Description.description: Workflow for /details <id>: calls get_m365_roadmap_by_id on the MCP server (HTTP JSON-RPC, like Harvest) and, when the Microsoft 365 roadmap has no such item, get_azure_update_by_id; an id written as azure-<id> goes to Azure Updates only. Returns the full item. The only agent flow that calls the MCP server.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Subscribe
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /subscribe (alias /add): matches each comma-separated name to a pack or product in SPEC order, checks the per-user cap on distinct products after pack expansion, and creates the missing ait_subscription rows.

Description.description: Workflow for /subscribe (alias /add): matches each comma-separated name to a pack or product in SPEC order, checks the per-user cap on distinct products after pack expansion, and creates the missing ait_subscription rows.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Set Look-ahead
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /lookahead <months>: sets ait_lookaheadmonths (1-24; the topic validates the number).

Description.description: Workflow for /lookahead <months>: sets ait_lookaheadmonths (1-24; the topic validates the number).

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Set Frequency
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /frequency: sets ait_frequency and ait_weekday and recomputes ait_nextdueon from now (lib nextdue). The topic parses and validates the arguments.

Description.description: Workflow for /frequency: sets ait_frequency and ait_weekday and recomputes ait_nextdueon from now (lib nextdue). The topic parses and validates the arguments.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Set Critical Window
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /critical <months>: sets ait_criticalwindowmonths (1-24; the topic validates the number).

Description.description: Workflow for /critical <months>: sets ait_criticalwindowmonths (1-24; the topic validates the number).

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Pause Resume
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /pause and /resume: sets ait_ispaused. Subscriptions are kept.

Description.description: Workflow for /pause and /resume: sets ait_ispaused. Subscriptions are kept.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - My Subscriptions
Workflow.Description: Workflow for /mysubs: shows the caller's packs and products, and the distinct products they cover after pack expansion.

Description.description: Workflow for /mysubs: shows the caller's packs and products, and the distinct products they cover after pack expansion.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Catalog Refresh
Workflow.Description: Weekly: reads the Product facet for items modified in the last 365 days from the MCP server and upserts every product into ait_product: Microsoft 365 roadmap products, then (when ait_HarvestAzure is on) Azure Updates products. New Microsoft 365 products land with no pack; a new Azure product is added to the pack of each of its Azure categories (ait_azurecategory). Writes one ait_runlog row per run.

Description.description: Weekly: reads the Product facet for items modified in the last 365 days from the MCP server and upserts every product into ait_product: Microsoft 365 roadmap products, then (when ait_HarvestAzure is on) Azure Updates products. New Microsoft 365 products land with no pack; a new Azure product is added to the pack of each of its Azure categories (ait_azurecategory). Writes one ait_runlog row per run.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Harvest
Workflow.Description: Daily at 06:00 UTC: reads Microsoft 365 roadmap items modified since the last successful Microsoft 365 harvest from the MCP server, classifies them and upserts them into ait_roadmapitem. Writes one ait_runlog row per run. The body is lib harvest, shared with Harvest Azure.

Description.description: Daily at 06:00 UTC: reads Microsoft 365 roadmap items modified since the last successful Microsoft 365 harvest from the MCP server, classifies them and upserts them into ait_roadmapitem. Writes one ait_runlog row per run. The body is lib harvest, shared with Harvest Azure.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Harvest Azure
Workflow.Description: Daily at 06:00 UTC: reads Azure updates modified since the last successful Azure harvest from the MCP server, classifies them (retirement from the Retirements tag) and upserts them into ait_roadmapitem as azure-<id>. Writes one ait_runlog row per run. Does nothing when ait_HarvestAzure is off. The body is lib harvest, shared with Harvest.

Description.description: Daily at 06:00 UTC: reads Azure updates modified since the last successful Azure harvest from the MCP server, classifies them (retirement from the Retirements tag) and upserts them into ait_roadmapitem as azure-<id>. Writes one ait_runlog row per run. Does nothing when ait_HarvestAzure is off. The body is lib harvest, shared with Harvest.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Send Digest
Workflow.Description: Child flow for the daily Digest flow: builds and posts one subscriber's digest with lib digest (scheduled = true also advances ait_nextdueon) and returns status, itemcount and message. A cloud flow, so it bills to Power Automate, not Copilot Studio.

Description.description: Child flow for the daily Digest flow: builds and posts one subscriber's digest with lib digest (scheduled = true also advances ait_nextdueon) and returns status, itemcount and message. A cloud flow, so it bills to Power Automate, not Copilot Studio.

Workflow.Name: AIT Roadmap Watch - Digest
Workflow.Description: Daily at 07:00 UTC (fixed in the trigger; keep ait_DeliveryHourUtc at the same hour): runs Send Digest for every subscriber who is not paused and whose ait_nextdueon is empty or before the end of today (UTC). Writes one ait_runlog row per run.

You review one item from the Microsoft 365 public roadmap. A keyword filter flagged it for one or more of three categories. Decide for each category whether the item really belongs to it. Judge only from the item text below. Do not use outside knowledge.

Categories:

isSecurity: true only if the item mitigates an active threat (phishing, malware, ransomware, exploitation, account compromise, a vulnerability) or changes a security default that users or admins will notice. False if the item simply adds or improves a security, compliance or identity feature that customers can choose to use.

isActionRequired: true only if an administrator or user must do something by a date, or something will break or stop working without action. False for optional settings, opt-in features, or general recommendations.

isRetirement: true only if a Microsoft product, feature, app, API or setting is being retired, deprecated, removed, discontinued or replaced for customers. False if the words describe something else, for example developers retiring their own tools, a retirement or holiday calendar, or replacing content inside a document.

retirementMonth: when isRetirement is true and the text states when the retirement takes effect, give that month as YYYY-MM. Otherwise null. Do not guess a month from the GA or preview date.

reason: one sentence, at most 200 characters, that a busy administrator can read in a digest. Say what happens and why it matters. If every category is false, say briefly why the keywords were a false alarm.
